title: Notifications
description: Account, tender and administrative updates in one place.

recommendationCreated.title: New tender recommendation
recommendationCreated.body: A new tender recommendation is ready for your review.

analysisCompleted.title: Analysis completed
analysisCompleted.body: Analysis version {versionNumber} is ready to review.

accountApproved.title: Account approved
accountApproved.body: Your account has been approved. You can now use your workspace.

documentsReady.title: Tender documents ready
documentsReady.body: {readyCount} of {totalCount} documents are ready for compliance analysis.

documentsPartial.title: Tender documents partially ready
documentsPartial.body: {readyCount} of {totalCount} documents are ready; {failedCount} could not be prepared.

documentsFailed.title: Tender document acquisition failed
documentsFailed.body: The tender documents could not be prepared. Open the tender to try again.

privateDocumentsFailed.title: Private document processing failed
privateDocumentsFailed.body: The private document pack could not be prepared. Open the workspace to review it.

fallback.title: Account update
fallback.body: This update is still available, but its original destination is no longer supported.

states.filteredEmptyHelp: Choose another filter to see more updates.
states.mutationFailure: The read state could not be changed. Your inbox has been restored.
